brand_voice_note: Playful and pun-loving with a blunt, founder-in-her-kitchen honesty that treats real-ingredient snacking as fuel for people who actually move.

concepts.primary_text:
Cookie dough that squeezes. Yes, it tastes exactly like that.

Creamy cashew butter folded with semi-sweet chocolate, real vanilla, and butter extract. 5g+ plant protein per pouch, low added sugar, and real ingredients you can pronounce.

Joy in every squeeze - 12 single-serve squeezies you can snack on the go. No bombs, no crashes. 🍪
concepts.headline: Cookie Doh' You Can Squeeze
concepts.why_it_works: The flavor that started it all leads with its most craveable promise - dessert-tasting snack fuel - which is the single most desirable outcome for this audience.
concepts.visual_direction: The sealed Cookie Doh' pouch standing upright on a bright marble kitchen counter with a few loose cashews and a chocolate square beside it in soft morning light.
